description: Myanmar Reservoirs is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Myanmar. Vector layer (polygons) of reservoirs identified in Myanmar from dam point dataset. Coverage: Myanmar. The portal files it under the publisher Open Development Myanmar. Its tags are Energy, Hydropower dams, Irrigation and water management, Water policy and administration. It offers 4 resource(s) in db_table, geojson, shp, wms. The portal shows 2021-06-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
